kaikki_vikisozluk.t: In Classical Arabic يَعْضِيض (yaʕḍīḍ), from عَضَّ (ʕaḍḍa, “to bite”) due to its jagged appearance, altered after a scheme known from جَرْبُوز (jarbūz) and جَرْبُوع (jarbūʕ), perhaps also under influence of the plant-names جَعْدَة (jaʕda) and جُعْدَة (juʕda).
g: endive (Cichorium gen. et spp. of the same tribe)
